mods.name: fastlogic
mods.author: REDEagle0705, Claude
mods.description:
Higher frame rates on large bases, same game.

Smooth frames: the game calculates 60 times a second (as it does at 60 fps) and only draws the frames in between, with units, players and bullets drawn between their last two positions. The game runs at the same speed; the frame rate is no longer held down by the calculation (largest campaign map: about 155 -> 550-680 fps).

Faster calculations with the same results (overflow/underflow gates, item and liquid bridges, unloaders with no item set, menders, overdrive projectors): the same items go the same way, in the same order, so it stays in step with servers and players without it.

Each part can be switched off in Settings > Fast Logic. Client-side, adds no content. Tested on v160.7.

mods.author: cardillan
mods.description:
This mod aims to make debugging in Mindustry Logic a bit easier:[[]lightgray]

Enhanced [[]accent]Vars[[]] screen: full precision values, sorting and filtering variables, copying variables to the clipboard.

[[]accent]Memory[[]] screen for inspecting contents of memory blocks, using the same interface as the [[]accent]Vars[[]] screen.

Settings for overriding instruction limit, by up to 1000 instructions, to make space for additional debugging code.

[[]accent]Snapshots[[]] allow saving, reviewing and restoring the state of logic processors, memory blocks and other entities.

A [[]accent]profiler[[]] for gathering statistics about program execution.

[[]accent]Logging[[]]: a custom `log` instruction creates logging messages that can be inspected from the UI.

Custom mlog instructions for performing runtime checks, logging messages, reporting errors, triggering a breakpoint, taking snapshots and managing profiling.

Visual indication of stopped processors, processors executing a [[]accent]wait[[]] instruction, and failed runtime checks, directly on the map.

[[]white]Using this mod on maps with lots of processors may impact the game's performance.[[]]

See the [[]accent]README.md[[]] file in the mod's GitHub repository for more information.

mods.description:
A Mindustry mod adding airstrikes.

The core mechanic of the mod are the Orbital Weapons, which are launched into orbit using satellites and the Launcher block.

Weapons in orbit are saved across game sessions and can be accessed from any sector on the planet they were launched from, or only from the sector they were launched from, if the sector is not on a planet (not in campaign).

Orbital Weapons are monitored via the Orbital Monitor and can be called to strike using the Beacon and the Orbital Controller.

- Console for mobile.

  + Select same types of selected units in screen -> whole map.
  + Units team assign, number 1 -> 9.
  + Add/remove units to/from current selected units.
  + Fast deselect all selected units.
- Notification: insprited by RA2, show a list of notifications on top-left, will fade out after a few secs.
- Chat supprort.
- Tags list allow manually sort, easier for tag selection.
- Block rotation for mobile.
- Memory viewer for Memory cell, Memory bank and World cell.
- Other shits!!!
